mentions.name: Asklet
mentions.description: A feedback collection tool that goes just a little beyond "give us a star rating" to collect more detailed feedback without being in-your-face or annoying.
mentions.problem: Simple star ratings capture little detail, while more demanding feedback requests come across as in-your-face or annoying.
mentions.source_excerpt: Professionally, my team just made our big new launch of a feedback collection tool - https://www.sunbeam.cx/asklet. It tries to go just a little beyond the "give us a star rating" and collect some more detailed feedback without being too in-your-face or annoying.
